messages:
maya: Quick check-in on VantEdge onboarding — noticed an odd latency split between streaming chat and non-streaming generation in their account metrics this week. Can we triage?

telemetry-bot: Automated report for account VantEdge (acct:v_edge):
```
routes:
  /v1/chat/stream  p95=210ms  p99=1.82s  errors=0.6%  tail=~2s
  /v1/chat        p95=190ms  p99=230ms   errors=0.1%
  /v1/generate    p95=180ms  p99=300ms   errors=0.05%
weekly_spend: $4,200 (↑18% vs last week)
active_sessions: 1.2k (streaming heavy)
notes: streaming requests have longer sequences, small default batch size
```

ravi: @maya thanks, grabbing logs now. :mag: Do you know which model variants they're pinned to?

maya: They pinned to "redwood-xxl-quant" for all routes. Customer said they prefer streaming for UX.

ethan: @ravi can you paste the recent runtime logs? looking for KV cache evictions or heavy compilation stalls.

ravi: log snippet: ```[2026-03-18T14:22:05Z] worker-3 WARN kv_cache: evict oldest 12 items (mem pressure)
[2026-03-18T14:22:05Z] worker-3 INFO batcher: batch size fluctuating 1→8→2
[2026-03-18T14:22:06Z] rpc: deadline exceeded to model-host-7
``` Might be intermittent GPU contention.

ethan: That batch size swing is a clue — streaming continuous batches get fragmented. Suggest enabling prefix caching for the chat route and increase min_batch to 4 for that pool. Also check NRT autoscaler metrics.

maya: Good call. Can we try a config change in staging and route ~10% of VantEdge traffic to it? We want to see p99 reduction before proposing to customer.

nora: (from VantEdge) noticing jitter in chat UI, sometimes responses arrive slower than regen. We have a kickoff next Tue — worried about SLA.

ethan: I'll prepare a canary config: set min_batch=4, enable prefix_cache=true, fallback_model=redwood-xl-quant. Will route 10% and feed telemetry.

ravi: Deployed canary at 14:45 UTC. telemetry-bot will post canary metrics in ~30m. @maya please notify VantEdge that we're investigating and expect follow-up.

maya: Notified them, said we'll update after canary. Thanks team. :thumbsup:

telemetry-bot: Canary update (10% traffic): /v1/chat/stream p95=205ms p99=620ms errors=0.15% — p99 improved 65% vs prod

maya: Excellent. Let's keep this on the watchlist and schedule a short enablement call next Tue to explain fallback behavior and cost tradeoffs (streaming vs non-streaming).
